context: The agent turns an existing `web probe` report (CloudFront blocking the HeadlessChrome User-Agent; first working step: stealth-ua) into the browser recipe `web probe` would have written, `browser-recipe.json`. Judge browser-recipe.json, the stealth script file it references, and answer.md.

checklist.name: recipe_written
checklist.description: browser-recipe.json exists in the working directory and is valid JSON with a `cliConfig` object and a boolean `persistent` field.

checklist.name: consumable_shape
checklist.description: The recipe has the shape `web probe` writes: `url`, `cliConfig.browser` with `browserName` and `launchOptions`, and `cliConfig.browser.initScript` as a list of file paths, so `--recipe` can load it.

checklist.name: ua_override
checklist.description: cliConfig.browser.launchOptions.args contains a `--user-agent=` value for a regular desktop Chrome that does not contain 'HeadlessChrome'.

checklist.name: stealth_script
checklist.description: The file listed in `cliConfig.browser.initScript` exists, is non-empty JavaScript that, at minimum, hides navigator.webdriver (the working step used the stealth init script), and the recipe does not inline the script as a string.

checklist.name: minimum_config
checklist.description: The recipe matches the first successful step (stealth-ua): `persistent` is false and it does not switch to system Chrome (`channel: "chrome"`).

checklist.name: diagnosis
checklist.description: answer.md attributes the block to CloudFront (server: CloudFront / x-amz-cf-id / 'The request could not be satisfied') filtering on the HeadlessChrome User-Agent, citing that stealth alone still failed and adding the UA override succeeded.

checklist.name: no_invented_signals
checklist.description: Does not claim protections absent from the report (e.g. Akamai, Cloudflare, DataDome) or claim to have re-run the probe.
